question: X can complete 1 over 4of a work in 3 days and Y can complete 1 over 6of the same work in 4 days. X and Y worked together for 6 days and Z alone completed the remaining work in 8 days. If Y and Z work together, how much time will they take to complete the same work?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

X can complete 1 over 4of a work in 3 days

Y can complete 1 over 6of the same work in 4 days.

**Calculation:**

Time taken by X to complete the work = 4 × 3 = 12 days

Time taken by Y to complete the work = 6 × 4 = 24 days

Let the total work be W

X's 1-day work = W/12, and

Y's 1-day work = W/24

∴ X + Y's 6-day work = 6 × (W/12 + W/24) = 3W/4

Remaining work = W - 3W/4 = W/4

Z completes the remaining work in 8 days, therefore

Z's efficiency = (W/4)/8 = W/32

∴ Y and Z's Combined Efficiency = W/24 + W/32 = 7W/96

Tine taken by Y and Z together = W/(7W/96) = 96/7 = 135 over 7 days

**∴ Y and Z together will take 135 over 7 days to complete the same work.**
